scope: code-owned incident response and rollback readiness bundle

controls.name: Incident readiness bundle structure generated
controls.proof: The generator created the required redacted owners/escalation, rollback tag, database restore plan, runbook review, post-deploy watch, sample alert test, and manifest files.

controls.name: Rollback safeguards are documented
controls.proof: Rollback guidance prohibits deleting customer order, payment, FET ledger, pool settlement, bell request, notification, or audit history and prefers forward-fix migrations for already-applied database changes.

controls.name: Post-deploy watch signals are mapped
controls.proof: The generated watch file maps the Supabase operations snapshot, runtime telemetry, ordering, manual payments, FET ledger, pools, staff calls, push notifications, and LiveScore freshness to rollback thresholds.

controls.name: Private owner data is not committed
controls.proof: The generated bundle uses redacted placeholders for owners, escalation channels, and provider alert routes; no private phone numbers, private emails, tokens, or customer data are required in tracked evidence.

commands.proof: Validator checks this evidence, generated bundle files, manifest, incident runbook, rollback runbook, and generator script.

pendingExternalEvidence: Named incident commander, technical owner, support owner, and release owner signoff.
Private escalation channel and backup owner evidence stored in the approved operations system.
Immutable release tag creation and push proof.
Production backup manifest and restore drill evidence.
